Welcome to CLMPC where we discover a comprehensive array of medical and psychological treatments tailored to you or your child’s unique needs. We offer a safe and supportive environment where patients and their families feel comfortable discussing their concerns and receiving the quality care they need. Dr. Lauren Stokes established CLMPC in 2021 after the loss of Dr. James Quillin who inspired her to pursue medical psychology training. Our mission is to continue Dr. Quillin’s legacy by offering comprehensive and collaborative psychological and medical care. Dr. Stokes and her team of medical psychologists, social workers, and counselors have expertise in treating a range of mental health illnesses such as anxiety, autism, depression, mood disorders, ADHD, and PTSD. Our clinic provides thorough evaluations in order to determine treatment options that can include therapy and medication management. We work collaboratively with your physicians to ensure comprehensive psychological and medical care. We are honored to serve our community in Central Louisiana and look forward to meeting you.

We treat all ages including pediatrics, adolescents, and adults.
